■ When you put this tamaseed, choose one of the following.
:► Draw a card.
:► Put a light evolution creature that costs 7 or less from your hand. That creature gets "blocker" until the start of your next turn. (You may tap a creature that has "blocker" to change the attack target of your opponent's creature to that creature.)
